years_since_diagnosis.evidence: living with Crohn's for twelve years now... Diagnosed at 26

occupation.evidence: First symptoms during bar exam prep... Made partner despite everything... Lawyer salary helps.

location.evidence: Colonoscopy showed extensive disease; primary symptoms are bloody diarrhea and cramping, consistent with colonic involvement. No mention of small bowel or ileal disease specifically.

severity.evidence: Extensive disease on colonoscopy, failed multiple therapies (mesalamine, azathioprine, methotrexate, Remicade, Humira), currently on Stelara with only partial response ('working okay, not great'), six months of insurance appeals while suffering, considering combo therapy and fecal transplant trials.

disease_control.evidence: Currently on Stelara. Working okay. Not great, just okay.

extraction_notes: Synthroid excluded from treatments as it is for thyroid disease (comorbidity), not Crohn's. Chronic migraines and thyroid disease recorded as comorbidities only. Combo therapy (Stelara plus something else) and fecal transplant trials are being discussed/considered but not yet started; not added to treatments.
